basis: C2H2 zinc finger (gynoecium patterning; Payne 2004 Development); pKNU:KNU-Venus marks the MMC (Tucker et al. 2012 Development; used as MMC marker by Cao et al. 2018 PLoS Genet), and is specific to the Hou 2021 MMC subclusters (18-24% vs <=3%; AGGR C11 log2FC 5.6). Cross-study agreement raised medium to high. Low detection rate; also log2FC 2.9 in the small AGGR C14 (phloem-like) cluster.

Meiosis-specific chromosome-axis protein, immunolocalized to meiocyte chromatin (Armstrong et al. 2002 J Cell Sci); 39-48% of Hou 2021 MMC subcluster cells vs <=4% elsewhere, log2FC 5.1-6.0. Meiotic prophase only (stage-restricted); agreement across studies raised to high. Also in male meiocytes if anthers are sampled.

Meiotic recombinase; promoter-GUS in pollen and megaspore mother cells (Klimyuk and Jones 1997 Plant J), dmc1 female meiocyte phenotype (Couteau et al. 1999 Plant Cell); Hou 2021 MMC subclusters log2FC 4.0-4.7. Meiosis-stage restricted; cross-study agreement raised to high.
Meiosis-specific cyclin needed for homolog interaction (Azumi et al. 2002 EMBO J); 32% of Hou 2021 MMC1.10-s3 cells, AGGR C11 log2FC 3.9. No cell-resolution localization found.
Required for female meiosis and sister-chromatid cohesion (Siddiqi et al. 2000 Development; Mercier et al. 2001 Genes Dev); 31-39% of Hou 2021 MMC subcluster cells vs <=4%, AGGR C11 log2FC 5.2.
Meiotic pairing/recombination factor (Kerzendorfer et al. 2006 J Cell Sci); Hou 2021 MMC subcluster feature gene (log2FC 3.5-3.6), AGGR C11 2.9.
Meiotic chromosome-axis protein (Ferdous et al. 2012 PLoS Genet); Hou 2021 MMC2.6-s3 feature gene (log2FC 3.6), AGGR C11 2.4.
Meiosis II spindle orientation (d'Erfurth et al. 2008 PLoS Genet; shown in male meiosis); Hou 2021 MMC subcluster feature gene (log2FC 3.3-3.9), AGGR C11 3.8.

Callose synthase of meiocytes/microspores (Dong et al. 2005 Plant J, anther); ovule MMC role not shown. Strongest single-cell enrichment in Hou 2021 (MMC2.6-s3 log2FC 5.8; AGGR C11 7.4); also 1.7 in AGGR C14.
CCCH zinc finger needed for meiocyte callose in anthers (CALLOSE DEFECTIVE MICROSPORE1); top Hou 2021 MMC feature gene (log2FC 6.4-7.1, AGGR C11 4.7); no ovule localization.
Small secreted protein specifying anther sporocyte/tapetum fate; feature gene of Hou 2021 AGGR.11-s2 only (log2FC 4.5), not enriched at cluster level (AGGR C11 0.8).

ERECTA-family receptor kinase; pERL1:GFP in distal nucellar epidermis from MMC1 stage, and er erl1 erl2 ovules form supernumerary MMCs (Hou et al. 2021 Commun Biol Fig. 9); ER-family ovule role also in Pillitteri et al. 2007 Development. Hou AGGR.11-s3 feature; AGGR C11 2.6, C5 1.8. Also expressed in stomatal lineage of carpel walls.
ERECTA receptor kinase; pER:GFP in distal nucellar epidermis (Hou et al. 2021 Fig. 9b), function redundant with ERL1/ERL2. Not enriched in any Hou 2021 cluster (AGGR C11 0.4).
ERECTA-like 2; pERL2:GFP in inner-integument epidermis, then distal nucellar epidermis (Hou et al. 2021 Fig. 9c). Also integument: check against Inner_Integument markers. AGGR C11 2.5, C5 1.8.

Phosphoglycerate dehydrogenase (serine synthesis); pPGDH1:3xVenus in distal nucellar epidermis near the inner integument, AC-MMC2 (Hou et al. 2021 Fig. 8a). Conflict: scRNA put it in the MMC1.10-s3 germline subcluster (log2FC 2.3).
Auxin efflux carrier; PIN1-GFP in nucellar epidermis of ovule primordia (Ceccato et al. 2013 PLoS One). Broad: highest in Hou 2021 AGGR C12 (procambium-like, log2FC 3.4); also provascular strand.

Required for sporogenesis and nucellus patterning; in situ in nucellus and sporogenous cells (Yang et al. 1999 Genes Dev; Schiefthaler et al. 1999 PNAS). Hou 2021 used it for nucellar epidermis but it is detected in only 2-11% of those cells; AGGR C11 3.9, C5 1.9.

Homeodomain TF expressed in the nucellus, required non-cell-autonomously for integument initiation (Gross-Hardt et al. 2002 Genes Dev). Layer conflict: Hou 2021 calls it a nucellar-epidermis marker; sparse there (2-11% of cells).

Probable pectate lyase 15; reporter in central nucellus at MMC1 and integument epidermis at MMC2 (Hou et al. 2021 Fig. 8b). Conflict: a feature gene of the scRNA MMC subclusters (log2FC 4.0-4.2) though the reporter is somatic. Not an MMC marker.

WRKY TF in hypodermal somatic cells around the MMC; restricts MMC fate (Zhao et al. 2018 PNAS). Not supported by Hou 2021 (same lab, not independent): 9-40% of subcluster cells and depleted in the germline cluster (AGGR C11 log2FC -3.6).

YABBY TF; in situ in abaxial outer-integument layer, required for outer-integument growth (Villanueva et al. 1999 Genes Dev). Present from stage 2-III; Hou 2021 AGGR C11 3.3, C5 2.2 (clusters not labelled by authors).
KANADI TF; in situ at the abaxial inner integument / integument boundary, needed for separate integument growth (McAbee et al. 2006 Plant J). Hou 2021 AGGR C5 2.9, C11 2.3 (unlabelled).
BELL homeodomain TF; in situ in chalaza and integument primordia, bel1 lacks integuments (Reiser et al. 1995 Cell). Not chalaza-only. Hou 2021 AGGR C11 2.4, C5 1.5.

C2H2/WIP zinc finger expressed in the transmitting tract and required for its development (Crawford et al. 2007 Curr Biol). Carpel carryover with placenta. Hou 2021 AGGR C10 2.6 (inferred septum cluster).
bHLH expressed in septum and transmitting tract; hec mutants lack transmitting tract (Gremski et al. 2007 Development). Hou 2021 AGGR C10 3.2.

Cytokinesis-specific syntaxin, G2/M (Lauber et al. 1997 J Cell Biol); top gene of two Hou 2021 "nucellar epidermis" subclusters (MMC1.10-s1, MMC2.6-s1), which are G2/M states. Same row in arabidopsis_leaf.tsv.
GRAS TF transcribed in G2/M as a MYB3R target, controls cell size (Takatsuka et al. 2022 Plant Signal Behav); feature gene of the G2/M subclusters in Hou 2021 (log2FC 2.6-4.0).
